notes: PILOT: training loss and tail family. Stack on the base: python -m dskit.pipeline workflow configs/workflow.json --args configs/pilot-base.json --args configs/pilot-crps-student.json. The manifest trains TorchCDF with Gaussian components on 0.1 x NLL + wing twCRPS; NLL chases outliers and Gaussian components understate fat tails, and the pooled MLP of the 2026-09-28 HPO study was too optimistic on the downside (10.24% of outcomes below its 5th percentile, docs/memos/2026-09-28-predictive-cdf-hpo.md). This run swaps both everywhere (steps 4 to 7): CRPS (robust, the scored metric) plus wing twCRPS, Student components, and the step-6 grid searches only the degrees of freedom (4, 8, 30; 30 is near-Gaussian) at the manifest's default width and learning rate, so 3 candidates instead of 9. Compare its report with pilot-base's: same folds, same references. Stack one step-6 pilot at a time (with pilot-regularize.json the axes would merge under one name pattern).
